title: Configure a personal API
summary: Configure Google, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or Anthropic Messages and load available models.
body: Open Model settings → Personal API, choose Anthropic Messages, and enter the API key, base URL, and text model. Load models reads /v1/models. Anthropic Messages supports text only and cannot generate images. Never paste an API key into Sci Guide.

title: Use submission and image modules
summary: Understand the basic workflows for ISMRM, RSNA, ER, ESC, ASCO, ESMO, and Image.
body: Choose a conference or Image from the home page. Submission modules follow analysis, generation, deep update, save, and blind-review workflows while applying organizer-specific rules and templates. Image supports text-to-image and image-to-image according to the selected BYOK or managed image capability.

title: Membership, credits, and sign-in
summary: Register, sign in, check in, recharge credits, and use managed member models.
body: Members can sign in with email or GitHub and receive {{signupCredits}} credits on registration. A manual daily check-in adds {{dailyCheckInCredits}} credit; a {{checkInStreakDays}}-day streak adds {{checkInStreakExtraCredits}} extra credit before the cycle restarts. Each managed abstract, image, or one-click creative task costs {{managedGenerationCredits}} credits; blind review costs {{blindReviewCredits}} credit. Personal BYOK takes priority; a managed service is used only when the matching personal capability is unavailable and enabled. If account status is missing, reopen the member panel and retry refresh.

title: Member cloud abstracts
summary: Save, synchronize, delete, and expand the personal cloud abstract allowance.
body: Signed-in members can synchronize generated results from the abstract library to their private cloud space. The default allowance is {{cloudDefaultAbstracts}} abstracts at up to {{cloudAbstractMaxKb}} KB each; expansion is managed in the member panel. On a version conflict, reload the cloud version before deciding whether to overwrite it.

title: Blind review and research verification
summary: Check ethics, de-identification, data, and citations with clear external-evidence limits.
body: Blind review is available beside generated results and checks ethics statements, patient de-identification, data consistency, and citation authenticity. Each managed member review costs {{blindReviewCredits}} credit. With the managed research verification agent enabled, members may select read-only PubMed, Semantic Scholar, or Hubble evidence tools. Authors must still verify every result.

title: Skills & MCP
summary: Enable bundled capabilities, managed research tools, or a supported external manifest.
body: In Model settings → Skills & MCP, enable the bundled blind-review skill, select managed read-only research tools, or import a supported JSON manifest. An external capability requires a supported adapter. Enabling it does not silently grant Sci Guide or other features permission to use it.

title: Common troubleshooting
summary: Resolve API silence, model-list failures, slow pages, missing member status, or locked models.
body: Check network and service health first, then confirm that provider, API key, base URL, and model ID use the same protocol. A locked model usually means its BYOK capability is missing or the managed member capability is disabled. Re-authenticate and refresh missing member status; preserve only the public error code when filing a GitHub Issue.

title: AI safety, accuracy, and privacy
summary: Understand generative-AI limits and avoid submitting secrets, patient identifiers, or unverified data.
body: AI analysis, editing, images, and help answers may be inaccurate and do not guarantee compliance, acceptance, or publication. Never upload identifiable patient information or paste API keys, access tokens, research text, or payment details into Sci Guide. Authors must verify all output against current official requirements.
